options.text_cn: 己方走任何棋都会立即被将杀
options.text_en: Every move you make results in immediate checkmate

options.text_cn: 一方被迫走棋，但任何走法都会使自身局面变差
options.text_en: A player must move, but every available move worsens their position

options.text_cn: 双方都无棋可走，局面形成和棋
options.text_en: Neither player has a legal move, so the game is drawn

options.text_cn: 己方棋子数量太少，只能被动应对
options.text_en: You have too few pieces and can only respond passively

explanation_cn: 逼着是指一方面临走棋反而更坏但又必须走棋的困境。由于国际象棋规定每步必须走棋，这一义务本身就成为了一种负担。局面越微妙，逼着的杀伤力越大。
explanation_en: Zugzwang is a position in which a player would prefer to pass, but must move, and every legal move makes their position worse. The obligation to move becomes a disadvantage. The more precise the position, the more decisive zugzwang can be.
